decision_rule.engine: apps/core/src/lib/orbital - the production module, not a stub
decision_rule.reference_record: Sentinel-1 AUX_POEORB precise orbit, Copernicus, sub-metre, published before the case was minted
decision_rule.case_form: a window of consecutive state vectors presented as an orbital track
decision_rule.reference_frame: the reference record is published EARTH_FIXED and is declared as such to the register, which converts it before applying any energy invariant
decision_rule.variant_construction: every variant is derived deterministically from sha256(case_id || family || rung_index), so the catalogue is reproducible from published data and carries no free parameter
decision_rule.acceptance: the register SHOULD report at least one violation for a faulted variant and none for a clean one. A faulted variant below the register resolution is expected to be missed, and those rungs are in the ladder on purpose
decision_rule.trial_rule: per case, draw u in [0,1) from the selection seed; u < 0.25 selects the clean variant, otherwise select uniformly among the faulted variants. Registered before the beacons publish
decision_rule.scoring: detection rate per family per rung with Wilson 95 percent intervals; a detection floor defined as the lowest rung at and above which detection is at least 0.95; and the beacon-selected trial scored from verdicts already committed in the catalogue
decision_rule.floor_test: the catalogue MUST contain at least one rung per family whose detection is below 0.05. A ladder whose lowest rung is still detected was chosen to flatter and is not evidence of a floor
